stories.title: Alibaba announces plans to list T-Head, its Nvidia chip rival
stories.summary: Alibaba noted it had already filed confidentially on Sept. 11 to list T-Head on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
stories.zh_title: 阿里巴巴宣布計畫讓英偉達晶片競爭對手 T-Head 上市
stories.zh_summary: 阿里巴巴指出，它已於 9 月 11 日秘密提交 T-Head 在香港證券交易所上市的申請。

stories.title: Investors pivot to defensive stocks as markets enter a ‘state of alert’
stories.summary: Technology stocks have lost momentum while defensive sectors gain ground, as investors reassess risks.
stories.zh_title: 隨著市場進入“警戒狀態”，投資者轉向防禦性股票
stories.zh_summary: 隨著投資者重新評估風險，科技股失去了動力，而防禦性板塊則上漲。

stories.title: U.S., China should ‘harbor no illusions’ as they cooperate, compete on AI, Bessent says
stories.summary: During Xi's September visit, Washington and Beijing agreed to launch an AI dialogue with a communications channel to help defuse serious incidents.
stories.zh_title: 貝森特表示，中美不應在人工智慧領域合作和競爭時抱持任何幻想
stories.zh_summary: 在習近平 9 月訪問期間，華盛頓和北京同意透過通訊管道啟動人工智慧對話，以協助化解嚴重事件。

stories.title: Anthropic opens Australian retail IPO offering as AI scrutiny intensifies
stories.summary: Anthropic opened its Australia retail IPO offering on Wednesday, allowing individual investors to apply for shares ahead of its planned IPO.
stories.zh_title: 隨著人工智能審查的加強， Anthropic在澳大利亞開放零售IPO
stories.zh_summary: Anthropic於週三開啟了澳大利亞零售IPO發行，允許個人投資者在計劃的IPO之前申請股票。

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
stories.summary: Google is rolling out its latest AI model, Gemini 4 Carbon, to the general public after releasing it to a select group of "cybersecurity defenders" two weeks ago. Google claims Carbon is its "strongest model" yet, and capable of competing with the very best systems from Anthropic and OpenAI. Google says Gemini 4 Carbon "pushes […]
stories.zh_title: 谷歌推出Gemini 4 Carbon特工“swarm”功能
stories.zh_summary: 谷歌正在向公眾推出其最新的人工智能模型Gemini 4 Carbon ，兩週前將其發布給一羣精選的“網絡安全捍衛者”。Google聲稱Carbon是其「最強大的模型」，能夠與Anthropic和OpenAI的最佳系統競爭。Google

stories.title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
stories.summary: For years, Anthropic has been known for its focus on enterprise and coding tools that attract high-flying corporate clients, inspiring competing frontier labs - like OpenAI, SpaceXSI, and Meta - to copy its strategies. Earlier this year, Claude Code went through its own particular hype cycle. And now, Anthropic is trying to expand its footprint […]
stories.zh_title: Anthropic現在擁有自己的人工智慧辦公室套件
stories.zh_summary: 多年來， Anthropic一直以專注於吸引高飛企業客戶的企業和編碼工具而聞名，激勵OpenAI、SpaceXSI和Meta等競爭前沿實驗室複製其策略。今年早些時候， Claude Code經歷了自己獨特的炒作週期。

stories.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
stories.summary: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.
stories.zh_title: Meta的AI代理Muse登陸Apple Watch和Android Wear OS
stories.zh_summary: 使用者現在可以透過Apple Watch上的語音通話、簡訊或聽寫與Meta的AI助手進行互動。

stories.title: CoreWeave beats on revenue and lifts guidance, easing AI slowdown concerns
stories.summary: CoreWeave's stock has been hammered heading into the neocloud's Q3 earnings report.
stories.zh_title: CoreWeave擊敗收入和提升指導，緩解AI放緩的擔憂
stories.zh_summary: CoreWeave的股票已被納入新雲的第三季度收益報告。

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
stories.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
stories.zh_title: 隨著紐約人工智慧安全法生效， OpenAI、Anthropic面臨新的監督
stories.zh_summary: 紐約正準備執行全面的人工智能安全法，要求OpenAI和Anthropic等主要開發商註冊、披露安全措施，並報告重大事件或面臨罰款。

stories.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
stories.summary: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”
stories.zh_title: Oura將以6.25億$收購AI原生初級保健初創公司Counsel Health
stories.zh_summary: 這筆交易發生在Oura無限期推遲其高達22億$的IPO幾週後，理由是「IPO市場的不確定性」。

stories.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
stories.summary: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.
stories.zh_title: PSI正試圖利用人工智慧驅動的科學發現做生意
stories.zh_summary: PSI使用未發布的人類模型來回答科學家近二十年來追求的關於量子計算的基本問題。

stories.title: CoreWeave’s stock pops as new financing playbook eases debt concerns
stories.summary: A third-quarter revenue beat and $9 billion in planned prepayments gave investors renewed confidence in CoreWeave’s business.
stories.zh_title: 隨著新的融資劇本緩解債務問題， CoreWeave的股票彈出
stories.zh_summary: 第三季營收超過預期，預付金額達90億$ ，讓投資者對CoreWeave的業務重拾信心。

stories.title: Jim Cramer says Anthropic's explosive growth could justify a record-breaking IPO
stories.summary: "The fact that this deal is on is bullish for tech and the AI trade," CNBC's Jim Cramer said Tuesday.
stories.zh_title: Jim Cramer表示， Anthropic的爆炸性增長可能是破紀錄的首次公開募股的理由
stories.zh_summary: CNBC的吉姆·克萊默(Jim Cramer)周二表示：「這筆交易正在進行，這對科技和人工智能貿易是有利的。」

stories.title: Jim Cramer: Wall Street is focusing too much on what could go wrong instead of right
stories.summary: Investors shouldn't let mounting market risks overshadow the potential for a rebound, CNBC's Jim Cramer said Tuesday.
stories.zh_title: 吉姆·克萊默：華爾街過度關注可能出錯的地方，而不是正確的地方
stories.zh_summary: CNBC的Jim Cramer周二表示，投資者不應該讓日益增加的市場風險掩蓋反彈的可能性。

stories.title: Stocks fall as the 10-year Treasury yield nears 5% mark
stories.summary: “I don’t think they should be raising another 25 basis points,” one portfolio manager said about the Federal Reserve’s benchmark interest rate.
stories.zh_title: 隨著10年期美國國庫券孳息率接近5%大關，股市下跌
stories.zh_summary: 一位投資組合經理談到聯準會的基準利率時表示：「我不認為他們應該再加息25個基點。」

stories.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
stories.summary: Former SignalFire investor Sahir Raoof raises $27.5 million for new fund targeting AI in pharma.
stories.zh_title: Proximal Ventures籌集首次亮相資金，以支持將AI帶入藥物開發的初創公司
stories.zh_summary: 前SignalFire投資者Sahir Raoof籌集了2750萬$ ，用於製藥業的人工智能新基金。
